composition.serve_who: This is the vessel's +24V DC Distribution schedule (GMMS 108'-111), showing two physical panels — AFT PANEL DC BREAKERS and FWD PANEL DC BREAKERS — plus an EMERGENCY POWER SUPPLY sub-panel, an EMERGENCY PANEL, and a small GMDSS breaker group. Each breaker row (Q-prefix in the main panels, QE-prefix in emergency supply, CB-prefix in emergency panel) feeds ONE named 24V DC load. Per the class rule, every load's owning equipment/system is identified by its printed name (using the engineer-confirmed mapping table where available); the panels/rails/service-supply fuses themselves are infrastructure belonging to 640-dc-distribution. Two CT (current transformer) monitoring taps (CT9 on WATER MAKER, CT10 on AUTOPILOT PUMP) are inline current-monitoring points on their respective breaker feeds, not separate loads. A small relay Re/ with B&G contact appears to switch/indicate the B&G breaker feed. Emergency battery feed via CT7 continues to DWG 111a (cross-ref only).

facts: AFT PANEL DC BREAKERS: two-column layout, breakers Q1-Q22 (main load rows) plus Q23-Q44 (right column) plus Q45-Q54 (top block for nav/electronics loads).
FWD PANEL DC BREAKERS: breakers Q1-Q20 plus emergency section QE1-QE4.

24V SERVICE SUPPLY: separate high-current fused/switched feed bank at sheet left (F5 100A, F6 200A, F7 60A, F8 60A, plus an illegible ~50A fuse) supplying SW6-SW9 switches and solenoids SO6/SO7, feeding BILGE PUMP, FIRE PUMP, TENDER WINCH directly — bypassing the Q-breaker schedule.

CTB7=QI-POWER-485-300-LV, CTB8=QI-POWER-485-LV, CTB9=QI-POWER-485-LV, CTB10=QI-POWER-485-LV — text legend identifying current-transformer/monitoring module part types (CT7-CT10) used across this and related sheets.
CT7 (to ONYX / +24V emergency battery feed) continues to DWG 111a — cross-reference only.
CT8 near top of sheet on a line labeled 'to ONYX' — monitoring tap, target/load not clearly resolved on this sheet.
Diamond wire-gauge callouts '4' and '6' appear on wires near EMERGENCY LTS and toward FWD PANEL — indicate conductor size continuation markers, not equipment.

EMERGENCY POWER SUPPLY panel (QE1-QE8) and EMERGENCY PANEL (CB5-CB8, includes GMDSS CB7/CB8 sub-group) are distinct sub-panels from the main AFT/FWD DC breaker schedule, fed from the +24V EMERGENCY BATTERY via CT7 (continuing to DWG 111a).
